title: build_inspector's proofs reach the system temp directory only through the scratch door
intention: Every proof in cairn/machines/build_inspector takes its temp directory from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir, so nothing a build_inspector proof makes outlives its run.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: bare_temp_reach over the repo named 2 build_inspector line(s): cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_no_iou_stands.py:46 (root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="testing-no-iou-stands-")), landed under f5dbfddea8c6); cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_no_iou_stands.py:123 (bare = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="testing-no-iou-stands-nogit-")), landed under f5dbfddea8c6); so cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py::test_no_proof_in_this_repo_calls_mkdtemp_bare reds. cc_0's 9859b8d64 (ticket 383ac6351996): the LF hook proof took its temp dir from scratch_dir after the scratch-door proof redded its bare mkdtemp.
traces_to: Law 4 (the scratch door is physics, and these lines step around it) and CP6 (what a proof leaves in /tmp accumulates unseen; 3581 dirs did once).
how: At each site, replace Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=P)) with scratch_dir(P), imported from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch, and drop the tempfile import where nothing else uses it: cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_no_iou_stands.py:46 (root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="testing-no-iou-stands-")), landed under f5dbfddea8c6); cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_no_iou_stands.py:123 (bare = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="testing-no-iou-stands-nogit-")), landed under f5dbfddea8c6). Precedent: cc_0's 9859b8d64 (ticket 383ac6351996): the LF hook proof took its temp dir from scratch_dir after the scratch-door proof redded its bare mkdtemp. The standing door proof cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_build_inspectors_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py (ticket 2bac0ebce3a8) already reds over these lines; its PROVES gains this ticket's key on the same tooth test_no_proof_in_build_inspector_reaches_temp_bare, so the crossing names it. Proofs-only build: the ticket carries a top-level writes_to.

clauses.claim: bare_temp_reach over cairn/machines/build_inspector names no line, so no build_inspector proof reaches the system temp directory except through scratch_dir

decisions.text: D1: each named site takes scratch_dir(prefix) in place of Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=...)).

D2: cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_build_inspectors_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py gains this ticket's PROVES key on its standing tooth test_no_proof_in_build_inspector_reaches_temp_bare.

out: every other component's bare sites (each in its own ticket, RULE 1)
cairn/tools/scratch (the door and the scan are unchanged)
